title: SLO Prioritization Funnel + Release-Gating Simulator for Initiative Planning
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an initiative-level tracker and interactive simulator that helps PMs and Eng leads prioritize reliability work by projecting SLI burn, mapping initiatives to SLO targets, and evaluating release gating impact. The tool will ingest SLI telemetry, error-budget runway assumptions, and proposed initiative effort to produce a ranked funnel and a gating policy simulator for release readiness decisions. Goals: 1) make trade-offs explicit (latency vs. cost vs. risk), 2) reduce manual spreadsheet work across cycles, and 3) provide a policy that can auto-recommend canary throttles or rollback windows based on simulated burn scenarios.
success_criteria: Interactive simulator accepts SLI time-series and initiative effort estimates and outputs a ranked initiative funnel
Simulator can run 3 burn scenarios (baseline, regression, spike) and show probability of crossing error-budget within 30/90 days
Exportable release-gating decision summary (pass/warn/fail) for engineering leads and PMs
Integrates with Console telemetry (per-route SLI) and flags dependent services with dependency sensitivity score
milestones: M1: Spec and data contract for telemetry ingestion (2026-02-24)
M2: Minimum viable simulator UI + backend run (2026-03-15)
M3: Integrate with Console SLI endpoints and rollout simple gating rules (2026-03-31)
M4: Beta with two product teams and feedback loop (2026-04-15)
M5: Rollout and playbook for SRE/PM decision use (2026-04-30)
risks: Telemetry gaps: missing per-route SLIs will reduce simulation fidelity
Overconfidence: teams may treat simulator output as absolute rather than probabilistic
Data sensitivity: exporting decision summaries may expose internal metrics — need access controls
Operational complexity: gating automation must be conservative to avoid blocking releases unnecessarily
